evals.name: syntactic-and-semantic-correctness
evals.prompt: Implement the requested component adhering to codebase architecture and idioms.
evals.expected_output: Clean code changes with proper typing, error handling, tests, and zero regressions.

assertions.name: compilation / syntax validity
assertions.check: code parses cleanly without syntax or AST errors

assertions.name: type safety
assertions.check: type checker passes with zero type errors or warnings

assertions.name: idiomatic conventions
assertions.check: follows naming, project structure, and import standards

assertions.name: test suite execution
assertions.check: all unit tests pass without failure or flake

evals.name: diff-minimalism-and-hygiene
evals.prompt: Perform targeted bugfix without introducing extraneous diffs or style churn.
evals.expected_output: Surgical diff touching only relevant lines and preserving surrounding comments.

assertions.name: bounded scope
assertions.check: diff affects only the necessary files and functions

assertions.name: no unrelated style churn
assertions.check: no formatting rewrites on untouched code blocks

assertions.name: preserved docstrings
assertions.check: existing docstrings and comments preserved verbatim
